candidates.description: A Boston-born, Harvard-educated man of about forty who went West. Cultured, precise diction, a low, smooth baritone, faint old New England accent, quiet and composed, dry wit, cold intelligence behind every word. Voice of a man on the 1880s American frontier, recorded close and dry like a film actor's dialogue, no music, no room echo. Unpolished and lived-in, not a modern announcer or narrator, not radio-smooth, no corporate or audiobook polish.
